description.value:
♋ Cancer rises Exalted today. This is the one day in two hundred and sixty. For the whole day your Techniques heighten as though you were 8 levels higher, and you have your Zenith Boon.

As the Ascendant Boon, plus The Yellow Spring Is Here — usable once today. 30-foot emanation: every enemy at half Hit Points or fewer must attempt a Fortitude save against your Cosmo DC or die. Incapacitation.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.isaacs-hb-pf2e.saint-class-features.Item.Ascendant Constellation]. A Zenith is scheduled by the GM, never rolled.
